verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an automation-capable customer-service agent platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows workflows, Procedures, outbound messaging and Monitors, but none of it documents running a job or workflow on a recurring schedule. Event-driven or one-off actions are not a recurring schedule, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
